blocks.headline: Kurz wiederholen
blocks.bodyGerman: »Wie spät ist es?« »Ich hätte gern einen Termin.« »Wir müssen jeden Tag arbeiten.«
blocks.bodyEnglish: Read the three sentences once. Then answer the questions. Every question can pin a concept to your concept book.

blocks.explanationEnglish: 14:45 is fifteen minutes before three o'clock. Informal German counts to the next hour.

concept.title: Inoffizielle Uhrzeit
concept.rule: Informal time counts the minutes to the next hour: nach = after, vor = before, halb = half.
concept.exampleEnglish: It is a quarter to three.

blocks.prompt: Fill the gap with am, um or von:

items.sentence: Mara arbeitet ___ neun bis siebzehn Uhr.

blocks.explanationEnglish: »um« introduces a clock time. »am« is for a day. »von … bis« marks a period of time.

concept.title: Zeitangaben: am, um, von … bis
concept.rule: am + Tag, um + Uhrzeit, von … bis + Zeitraum.
concept.exampleGerman: Mara arbeitet von neun bis siebzehn Uhr.

blocks.explanationEnglish: »die Tochter« is feminine. Feminine nouns keep »meine« in nominative and accusative.

concept.title: Possessivartikel
concept.rule: The possessive agrees with the noun: der → mein/meinen, das → mein, die → meine.

blocks.passage: Baue den Satz in korrekter Reihenfolge:
blocks.prompt: Ordne die Wörter zu einem richtigen Satz.
blocks.explanationEnglish: The modal verb »müssen« is second. The main verb »arbeiten« goes to the end.

concept.title: Modalverben: die Satzklammer
concept.rule: The conjugated modal verb sits in position 2. The main verb goes to the end as an infinitive.

blocks.prompt: Match the German sentence to the English meaning:

pairs.german: Es tut mir leid, ich bin zu spät.
pairs.english: I am sorry, I am late.

pairs.german: Wir können nicht ins Kino gehen.
pairs.english: We cannot go to the cinema.

blocks.explanationEnglish: Read each German sentence. Find the English sentence with the same meaning.

concept.title: Redemittel der Lektion
concept.rule: Fix an appointment, apologize for being late, talk about your family, and make a plan.
